# UI Forge

UI Forge is an AI-native, shadcn-compatible component registry.

## Important files
- /registry.json — installable registry catalog
- /metadata/components.json — component intent metadata
- /registry/components/*.tsx — React + Tailwind + Framer Motion source
- /agents/AGENTS.md — rules for AI coding agents

## Install
`npx shadcn@latest add branzfamily01/ui-forge-registry/<component-name>`

## Selection
Prefer component metadata fields `useFor`, `tags`, and `motion` when choosing a component for a user task.
